recommendations.title: Review speaker-tag extraction and normalization
recommendations.action: Review approved speaker-tag patterns, expected role coverage, and transcript transformation logic; validate changes on a bounded representative sample before release.

recommendations.title: Validate material topic-distribution change
recommendations.action: Review evaluated period and direction groups against approved topic ontology changes, routing changes, and data-coverage differences before interpreting trend movement.

recommendations.title: Validate transcript-duration calibration
recommendations.action: Review duration-unit resolution, zero or invalid-duration handling, and transcript transformation quality for affected aggregate groups.

recommendations.title: Remediate prioritized completeness gaps
recommendations.action: Identify affected required fields, validate upstream field-population behavior, and add governed completeness monitoring for the affected coverage period or segment.

recommendations.title: Review transcript vocabulary and mistranscription patterns
recommendations.action: Review approved confusion lexicon coverage and transcription transformation behavior using only redacted, controlled validation material.

recommendations.title: Initiate controlled privacy-pattern review
recommendations.action: Route the aggregate privacy-pattern finding through the approved privacy and security review process. Do not export, display, or persist raw matched values during triage.

recommendations.title: Review transcription token-quality controls
recommendations.action: Validate governed vocabulary coverage, language-handling assumptions, and transcript-cleaning behavior before using affected text for downstream classification.
